commentary_segments.text: Let us find out what thirdorder distortion is given by a MOST and then by a bipolar transistor. As a bipolar transistor has the steepest transfer curve, and thus the highest g /I m CE ratio, it will also give the highest distortion. A MOST on the other hand, only has a square-law characteristic. It gives much less distortion. This is why it is used at the input of most receivers, as well as in other exotic technologies such as GaAs.
